label: Light Quality
description: Time-neutral lighting character — the physics of the light itself.

items.name: hdr-cinematic
items.text: cinematic high-dynamic-range lighting, anchored deep blacks and controlled specular highlights held in the same frame, volumetric depth between key and shadow

items.name: soft-diffused
items.text: soft diffused light from a broad source, gradual inverse-square falloff and open readable shadows with feathered edges

items.name: studio-softbox
items.text: perfect studio lighting from large softboxes, controlled highlight roll-off and clean soft-edged shadow transitions

items.name: hard-specular
items.text: hard specular light from a small distant source, crisp highlights snapping off every glossy surface, knife-edged parallel shadows

items.name: bounced-ambient
items.text: soft bounced ambient light filling from every direction, shadows barely whispering, form modeled by occlusion alone

items.name: glowing-low-key
items.text: low-key lighting, small islands of glow floating in expansive darkness, falloff doing the framing

items.name: high-key-airy
items.text: high-key lighting, luminous airy whites with detail floating in brightness, shadows lifted to pale grey

items.name: mixed-temperature
items.text: mixed color-temperature light, warm tungsten practicals fighting cool ambient for every surface, skin caught between amber and blue

items.name: raking-texture
items.text: hard light raking almost parallel to the surface, every ridge, pore and fiber throwing its own long micro-shadow, texture exaggerated into relief

items.name: subsurface-glow
items.text: strong backlight pushed through translucent material, subsurface scattering turning leaves, fabric edges and the rims of ears and fingers into glowing membranes lit from within
